  "message": "The 2006 product warranty reserve rollforward explains the increase. Starting from the 2005 reserve of $4 million (source:q11n4), 2006 pretax warranty charges of $4 million (source:q12n3) and $7 million of warranty obligations assumed in acquisitions (source:q14n0) added to the reserve, while 2006 cash outlays of $5 million (source:q13n0) reduced it. The net 2006 change is 4 + 7 - 5 = $6 million, which reconciles the 2005 reserve of $4 million to the 2006 reserve of $10 million (source:q11n3). Amounts are stated in USD millions per the source table.",

    "answer": "The reserve for product warranties increased by $6 million from 2005 to 2006 (from $4 million to $10 million).",
